hook: A giggling toddler hugging a stuffed toy runs laps around the house to stay up past bedtime
title: Stay up late... but keep running
caption:
The deal: he can stay up past bedtime, but only while he keeps running. The moment he stops, it's bed time.

One happy toddler, one stuffed toy, laps from the living room down the hallway and back. How long do you think he lasted?

Save this for the next "just five more minutes" night and follow for more real parent moments.
